steps.action: Open Settings > Organization > AI analysis; check the card order, chip and Request conversion switches
steps.actual: The Organization rail group has AI analysis as its own link to /settings/ai-analysis. Cards: Personal > Organization > Provider > Request conversion > Field prompts. Provider card aria-expanded=false. Chip reads Connected. Field prompts is the last card and has no collapse control. Request conversion switches: matter-preparation checked=false, contract-preparation checked=false, contract-conversion-analysis checked=false.

steps.action: Expand Provider; check the saved OpenRouter settings; Test connection
steps.actual: Provider OpenRouter, Model deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash. The API key input is blank and shows "Leave blank to keep the current key. Paste a new one to rotate." Test connection showed "Connection successful." after 1821 ms.

steps.action: Load models with the stored key; Search models; Refresh models; check that nothing is saved
steps.actual: Load models was enabled with the stored key (API key input blank). OpenRouter returned 444 models in 229 ms (truncated=false); deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash is in the list. The button then read Refresh models. The select had 445 options. Search models "deepseek-v4.1" left 2 options: Choose a model | DeepSeek: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash · deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash. Model stayed deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash after the search and after Refresh models. The connector's updatedAt did not change and no save request was sent.

steps.action: Field prompts: edit the notice-period prompt, press Enter, wait for the save result
steps.actual: Input "Notice period (days) prompt". Enter sent one save (200), kept no line break, and the stored prompt is now the edited text (overridden=true). "Reset to default" appeared for that prompt. maxlength=2000.

steps.action: Field prompts: Shift+Enter inserts a line break; clearing the prompt and leaving restores the saved text
steps.actual: Shift+Enter put a line break at the end of the text without saving. After clearing the input and leaving it, the box showed the saved text again and the stored prompt was unchanged. Save requests sent: 0.

steps.action: Field prompts: type in the effective-date prompt, press Escape, reload
steps.actual: Right after Escape the box showed the saved text. Save requests after Escape: 1. After reload the box showed the abandoned text; stored overridden=true. Reset to default in the pane restored the built-in prompt (overridden=false, equals default=true).

note.text: Escape saved the discarded text. The Escape handler reverts the draft and then blurs the input; the blur handler commits the stale draft (ai-field-prompts-card.tsx). The author removes the Escape sentence from the article, so this is a product-bug note, not a scenario failure. The prompt was restored with Reset to default.
